name: David M. Chan
title: Incoming Assistant Professor
fitReason: A new CS host prospect connecting language/multimodal reasoning with physical agentic learning and tactile VLAs. Recent robot contributions are concrete, although his stated primary agenda is pragmatic conversational AI and his UCI laboratory is not yet established.

physicalEvidence.summary: June 2026 T-Rex deploys learned tactile-reactive policies on a fixed-base Dexmate Vega-1 with two Sharpa Wave hands across 12 physical tasks and 16 trials per task; multistage scores include partial completion. Chan is a coauthor in the Berkeley-led multi-institution collaboration. Playful Agentic Robot Learning separately transfers code skills acquired in simulation into simple physical manipulation without finetuning model weights. Neither project proves UCI equipment availability.

shortVisit.summary: The current recruiting page addresses Fall 2027 PhD applicants and students already at UCI, including master’s students. No external visiting-student or eight-week summer invitation is stated. The January 2027 faculty start precedes the target summer but does not establish hosting capacity.

scoreReasons.fit: Grounded foundation-model and robot-learning contributions; main announced agenda remains conversational AI.
scoreReasons.physical: Recent actual execution but collaborative pre-UCI apparatus.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: No external short-term route verified; current student and PhD scope only.
scoreReasons.freshness: Full June 2026 robot studies, September 2026 researcher updates and official institutional listing.

unknowns: Preserve incoming status: his own current page specifies January 2027. UCI’s official CML faculty list links him, but does not independently establish that he has already arrived or that a lab is operational.

Physical work predates the UCI appointment; ownership, location and visitor access for UCI hardware remain unknown. Cap physical evidence at 20 rather than treating Berkeley or industry apparatus as his future UCI equipment.

T-Rex’s physical evaluation is distinct from its teleoperation dataset. The agentic-learning study is primarily simulation, with limited physical transfer; code-library improvement is not demonstrated finetuning of underlying neural policy weights.

Use the newly verified UC Irvine institutional supplement: non-UC graduate Visitor appointments are available in policy, but the department/International Center must choose and approve the actual category, dates, project and funding. The undergraduate non-degree 51% funding condition is not a universal graduate-visitor rule.

Summer 2027 invitation, eight-week duration, mentoring capacity, remote participation, financial support and fully personal-funding compatibility remain unconfirmed. Current-UCI student recruitment is not an external-master’s summer offer.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.

name: Han Liu
title: Orrington Lunt Professor of Computer Science; Professor of Statistics
department: Computer Science; Statistics; Industrial Engineering and Management Sciences (courtesy)
fitReason: Methods-oriented foundation-model mentor whose current scientific-AI agenda includes robotics and autonomous laboratories. A verified physical manipulation collaboration creates an embodied-AI connection, but robotics is one part of a wider scientific learning program rather than the sole lab focus.

physicalEvidence.summary: The September 2026 EmboAlign revision lists Han Liu with Northwestern affiliation and executes VLM-constrained video-generated plans on a physical Dobot Nova2. Six tasks receive ten trials each. This validates a coauthored model-driven physical pipeline, but not hardware owned by MAGICS or a student-accessible robot in Liu’s own space. MagicSim is explicitly described as a simulation runtime and is not counted as additional hardware.

shortVisit.summary: The current lab welcomes students and collaborators interested in foundation models and experimental systems, with public email. No explicit visiting-intern opening or summer 2027 eight-week route is stated; older visitor CVs are historical precedent only.

scoreReasons.fit: Foundation-model methods strongly relevant; main lab program is broader scientific AI.
scoreReasons.physical: Recent physical model-driven collaboration, without confirmed independent lab hardware.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: General collaboration and historical precedent do not establish current external short-term intake.
scoreReasons.freshness: Current university/lab records and full September 2026 primary revision.
